themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Missed garbage collection complaints spiked to 10 THIS WEEK, a 567% jump from the 1.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, suggesting a potential citywide sanitation disruption or localized service failure affecting Riverdale residents' basic waste management.
evidence: 10 missed collection complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.5 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Mirrors broader sanitation infrastructure stress in outer boroughs
reporting_angles: Call DSNY to determine if this is a route-specific issue, staffing shortage, or labor action affecting CD 208
Interview residents on how missed pickups are impacting block conditions and pest activity

themes_detail.label: Street Sign Hazards Epidemic
themes_detail.summary: Dangling street sign complaints exploded to 6 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 2300% spike from the 0.2 weekly average, representing a sudden public safety risk across the district that may indicate inadequate city maintenance protocols or storm damage.
evidence: 6 dangling street sign complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (8-week baseline)
2300% spike with z-score of 8.69 (highest statistical severity in dataset)
Safety concern for pedestrians and vehicles if signs fall
reporting_angles: Map the 6 complaints to identify geographic cluster and potential common cause (wind event, lack of inspection, contractor negligence)
Check DOT inspection schedules for CD 208 and request timeline for remediation

themes_detail.label: Pigeon Infestation Surge
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary pigeon condition complaints jumped to 4 LAST WEEK, a 967% increase from the 0.4 weekly average, signaling either an emerging pest control problem or degraded public space maintenance that warrants investigation into food sources and sanitation enforcement.
evidence: 4 pigeon complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (8-week baseline)
967% spike with z-score of 7.49 (high statistical significance)
Suggests food waste management or vendor/restaurant issues attracting birds
reporting_angles: Identify the specific locations of 4 complaints to determine if linked to restaurants, parks, or transit hubs
Interview NYC Parks and Health Department on pigeon control strategy and food waste enforcement in Riverdale

themes_detail.label: Construction Activity Surge
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints peaked at 19 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 280% jump from the 5.0 weekly average, indicating either uncoordinated development activity, inadequate permit enforcement, or construction-related noise and disruption that may converge with ongoing residential noise complaints.
evidence: 19 construction/plumbing complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 5.0 weekly average (8-week baseline)
310 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (188 alterations) suggest active development pipeline
reporting_angles: Cross-reference high construction complaints with specific DOB permits and developer names to identify problem actors
Determine if spike correlates with specific SNAD applications (Arlington Ave, Sycamore Ave) now in review phase

themes_detail.label: Overgrown Trees & Street Sweeping Neglect
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree complaints and street sweeping complaints both spiked 700-900% in the past 3 weeks (3-5 complaints each vs. 0.4-0.5 weekly baseline), suggesting systemic park and street maintenance failures tied to understaffing or budget constraints that align with persistent community board capital requests.
evidence: Overgrown tree: 3 complaints last week vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 5.42)
Street sweeping: 5 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (900% spike, z-score 4.5)
Community board has repeatedly requested new maintenance equipment and park upgrades (budget cycle pattern)
reporting_angles: Interview NYC Parks on staffing levels and maintenance budget cuts affecting CD 208
Identify whether both spikes reflect single departmental failure or separate contractor issues
